claim: ADA web accessibility federal lawsuit filings have grown dramatically since 2018, peaked at 3,255 in 2022, dipped in 2023-2024, then rebounded 27% in 2025
value_primary: 27% YoY increase in 2025 (2,452 to 3,117 federal filings)

value_specific.notes: 2018-2022 data from Seyfarth Shaw annual reports. 2025 data: Seyfarth Shaw March 2026. The 2019 surge coincided with the 9th Circuit Domino's ruling. The 2023-2024 dip was partly driven by procedural/jurisdictional tightening; the 2025 rebound is attributed to new plaintiff attorney firms entering the market.

sources.name: Seyfarth Shaw ADA Title III — 2025 annual report (March 2026)
Seyfarth Shaw — 2024 filings continued to decrease (April 2025)
Seyfarth Shaw — Plaintiffs set new record in 2022 (January 2023)
WCAGsafe — ADA lawsuit statistics 2025-2026 (historical chart compilation)

context: 2018 pre-Domino's ruling: 814 filings. Post-Domino's 9th Circuit opinion (Jan 2019): immediate surge to 2,235 in 2019. Long-term trajectory is strongly upward despite 2023-2024 dip. 2025 represents a return toward the 2022 peak. Note: these figures are federal courts only; state court filings (NY, CA) add substantial additional volume not captured here. The long-term growth is structural, not cyclical.
